note: What Rooky says when an item is opened in the Collection, built like JongClub's item pop-over: warm, about how the thing is made and what it is made of, never a price. A chess set from an era uses the pitch Rooky gives for it on the website (site: the key in apps/website/guide.json, item-sets-<set id>, recorded once in apps/website/audio/), so it is recorded once and heard in both places. Every other item has its own line here, recorded by tools/voice/record-pitches.py into apps/web-prototype/public/pitch/ in Rooky's voice, Toby. test/pitch.test.js checks every item has a line and every clip matches its words.

lines.pieces.regency.v1: Regency Gilt was made for a royal summer house by the sea. Black and white lacquer, polished until it shines like a mirror, with crowns and pearls in real gold leaf. Every game feels like a party at the palace.
lines.pieces.staunton.v1: This is the classic! The Staunton set is boxwood and ebony, turned on a lathe and carved by hand, way back in 1849. Almost every chess set in the world learned from this one.
lines.pieces.marble.v1: Carrara and Nero is real stone. White marble from Italy, the same kind Michelangelo carved, against shiny black marble from Spain. It's cool to touch, and it clacks so nicely on the board.
lines.pieces.cocoa-gilt.v1: A chocolate maker kept this set in the shop window! Bright gold against dark cocoa lacquer, polished until it looks good enough to eat. Please don't try, though.
lines.pieces.jade-onyx.v1: Jade and Onyx is calm and cool. Pale green jade, loved in China for thousands of years, against smooth black onyx. It's a quiet set for a clever player.
lines.pieces.gold-silver.v1: This one belongs in a trophy cabinet. Polished gold against cool platinum, and each side is trimmed with the other. It's the set of a true champion.
lines.pieces.ruby-chocolate.v1: Did you know ruby chocolate is real? It's pink, and it comes from special cocoa beans. Here it faces the darkest chocolate, glossy and smooth.
lines.pieces.milk-dark.v1: Milk and Dark is as shiny as a brand new chocolate bar. Creamy milk chocolate on one side, rich dark on the other. It's the top prize of the Cocoa Harvest.
lines.pieces.caramel-cream.v1: Golden caramel and fresh cream, with crowns and manes in gold leaf. It's soft, warm and sweet, just like its name. A treat from the Cocoa Harvest.
lines.pieces.crystal.v1: Look at it sparkle! Crystal Jewels are cut like the gems in a jeweller's window, clear crystal against jet black. Each kind of piece wears its own coloured jewel, so you can spot it at a glance.
lines.pieces.celestial.v1: Celestial Opal holds a rainbow inside. White and black opal, set in silver and sprinkled with golden stars. Look for the planets, the moon, and a comet on the knight.
lines.pieces.peacock.v1: Peacock Court is the proudest set of all. Ivory and peacock blue enamel in gold, with fanned tails and shining feather eyes. Every piece is ready to show off.
lines.pieces.army.v1: Chess began in India, as a battle game of elephants, horses and soldiers. The Royal Army brings them back, carved in sandalwood and ebony, with silk robes and gold armour. It's chess the way it first was.
lines.pieces.robots.v1: Beep boop! The Robot Squad is made of glossy toy plastic and shiny chrome, with eyes that glow. Every robot still wears its piece's badge, so you always know who's who.
lines.pieces.ocean.v1: Come under the sea! Coral Kingdom is carved in mother of pearl, with merfolk, an octopus, a seahorse and a coral castle. Their tails shimmer like fish scales.
lines.board.walnut.v1: Walnut and Maple is a proper wooden board, with a gold line round the edge. Warm, simple and beautiful.
lines.board.cocoa-cream.v1: Cocoa and Cream has squares like chocolate and cream, with tiny raspberry lines in between. Yum!
lines.board.tournament.v1: Green and buff, the colours of chess clubs and tournaments everywhere. This is the board the champions use.
lines.board.night-marble.v1: White and black marble, polished like the floor of a palace. Your pieces will glide across it.
lines.board.rosewood-gold.v1: Deep rosewood and honey squares, framed in real gold leaf. It glows when the lights are low.
lines.board.emerald-ivory.v1: Green marble with jade veins, next to warm ivory stone. It's like playing in a garden.
lines.board.obsidian.v1: Obsidian is glass from a volcano! Smoky and shiny, with a chrome rim, and reflections everywhere.
lines.board.sakura.v1: Sakura Lacquer is pink like cherry blossoms in spring. You earn it by playing seven days in a row.
lines.board.sandstone.v1: Pink and honey sandstone, from Jaipur, the Pink City. It feels warm, like a sunny afternoon.
lines.board.ruby-truffle.v1: Ruby lacquer and pale praline squares, with gold between them. It's sweet, and very fancy.
lines.board.gilded-ebony.v1: Black lacquer and ivory, with every line drawn in gold. Smart enough for a royal game.
lines.board.harvest-oak.v1: Golden oak from the Cocoa Harvest. It smells like autumn, if boards could smell.
lines.board.cacao-pod.v1: These squares are the colours of a ripe cacao pod and its beans. That's where chocolate comes from!
lines.board.single-origin.v1: The darkest wood, in a frame of black marble. It's the very top of the season track.
lines.board.nile.v1: Desert sandstone and blue lapis, with hieroglyphs carved round the frame. Fit for a pharaoh.
lines.board.athens.v1: White marble and green stone, with the Greek key pattern all the way round. Very Athens.
lines.board.roma.v1: Warm travertine and grey marble, framed in purple porphyry and bronze. The stones of ancient Rome.
lines.board.mughal.v1: White marble with flowers made of tiny stones, set into red sandstone, just like the Taj Mahal.
lines.board.ming.v1: Black lacquer and pale silk, with gold lines and a frame of red cinnabar. It's like the Forbidden City.
lines.board.venice.v1: Mirror glass and sparkly gold flecked glass, found by Murano's glassmakers by a lucky accident!
lines.board.belle.v1: Blue grey and white marble, in a frame of kingwood, like the grand houses of Paris.
lines.board.winter.v1: Rose pink stone and white onyx, framed in swirly green malachite from the Ural Mountains.
lines.board.deco.v1: Striped ebony and shiny chrome, straight from a fancy New York penthouse in the 1930s.
lines.room.salon.v1: The Grand Cocoa Salon is cosy, with candles, a chandelier and a crackling fire. My favourite place for a quiet game.
lines.room.library.v1: The Midnight Library has shelves of old books under a starry blue sky. Perfect for a thinking game.
lines.room.marble-hall.v1: The Marble Hall is white and gold, and bright as morning. Every move looks important in here.
lines.room.harvest-loft.v1: The Harvest Loft is warm and full of golden light. It's like playing in a barn at harvest time.
lines.room.nile.v1: Play at sunset, right below the Pyramids and the Sphinx! The sand glows orange all around you.
lines.room.athens.v1: A marble colonnade, with the Parthenon up on the hill. You can almost hear the philosophers thinking.
lines.room.roma.v1: Your table is on the floor of the Colosseum, with torches burning on every tier. What a place for a battle!
lines.room.mughal.v1: A garden by the long pool, with the Taj Mahal shining in the moonlight. It's so peaceful.
lines.room.ming.v1: Red lacquer and gold, facing the great hall of the Forbidden City. A study fit for an emperor.
lines.room.venice.v1: A balcony over the Grand Canal, with the Rialto Bridge and gondolas gliding by. Ciao, Venice!
lines.room.winter.v1: A palace ballroom, with colourful onion domes outside in the snow. Cosy and grand at the same time.
lines.room.deco.v1: A rooftop above Times Square, in a sea of neon lights. The city never sleeps, and neither does this game!
lines.room.paris.v1: A garden terrace right below the Eiffel Tower, all lit up for the World's Fair. Ooh la la!
lines.capture.cocoa-dust.v1: A polite bow, then a little hop to the tray in a puff of cocoa. Good manners, even in battle.
lines.capture.none.v1: Plain and simple. The taken piece just steps off to the tray.
lines.capture.gold-sparks.v1: A friendly duel with golden sparks, then a twirl and a bow to the winner. So graceful!
lines.capture.ruby-petals.v1: The two pieces dance a waltz around the square, then one twirls away. How lovely.
lines.capture.ink.v1: A magic trick! A swirl of ink smoke, and the taken piece pops up safe in the tray.
lines.capture.frost.v1: A frosty breath, a shiver of crystals, and the piece skates away across the ice. Brrr!
lines.capture.cocoa-nibs.v1: Leapfrog! One piece somersaults over, and the other bounces off in a shower of cocoa nibs.
lines.capture.caramel-sparks.v1: Two happy hops, then the piece whooshes up on caramel sparks. Like a little firework.
lines.victory.confetti.v1: Gold, ruby and cream confetti for every win. Let's celebrate!
lines.victory.none.v1: A quiet win, like a true gentleman. Sometimes a smile is enough.
lines.victory.sparks.v1: A shower of white and gold sparks, to make every win shine.
lines.victory.fireworks.v1: Colourful fireworks, as bright as Diwali night. Boom, you won!
lines.victory.petals.v1: Rose petals drift down over the board. A soft, pretty way to win.
lines.victory.harvest.v1: Golden fireworks for the harvest festival. A win worth cheering for!
lines.clock.classic.v1: A real tournament clock, with a glowing green display. Tick, tock, your move!
lines.clock.amber.v1: Warm amber numbers, like the glowing tubes in very old clocks.
lines.clock.ruby.v1: A ruby lacquer clock with soft pink numbers. Pretty, but it still keeps time.
lines.clock.gold.v1: A gold chronograph with a cream face, like a fancy watch.
lines.clock.ice.v1: Frosted glass and icy blue numbers. Stay cool under pressure!
lines.clock.harvest.v1: Polished brass with harvest gold numbers. Shiny and warm.
lines.sound.wood.v1: The soft knock of heavy wooden pieces on felt. My favourite sound in chess.
lines.sound.soft.v1: Quiet, gentle clicks, for calm and cosy games.
lines.sound.marble.v1: The bright clack of marble on marble. Every move sounds important!
lines.sound.glass.v1: Crystal chimes for every move. It sounds like magic.
lines.trail.none.v1: No trail, just neat and tidy moves.
lines.trail.gold.v1: A trail of golden dust behind every move. Sparkly!
lines.trail.mint.v1: A cool wisp of mint, light as a breeze.
lines.trail.ruby.v1: A ruby comet tail. Your pieces zoom like shooting stars!
lines.trail.caramel.v1: A sweet drizzle of caramel behind every move.
lines.trail.cinnamon.v1: A spicy cinnamon swirl. Your moves will look so fancy.
lines.avatar.knight.v1: A golden knight on ruby enamel. For players who jump into action!
lines.avatar.rook.v1: A golden rook on green enamel. Strong and steady, just like you.
lines.avatar.bishop.v1: A golden bishop on violet enamel. Sneaky, smart, and always diagonal.
lines.avatar.pawn.v1: A golden pawn on cocoa enamel. Small, but it can become a queen!
lines.avatar.queen.v1: The golden queen, the most powerful piece on the board.
lines.avatar.king.v1: The golden king. Only the very best players wear this one.
lines.avatar.truffle.v1: Truffle the bunny, your very first friend. So soft and kind!
lines.avatar.crown.v1: The Grandmaster Crown! Only for players who beat Ember the dragon.
lines.avatar.cocoa-pod.v1: A ripe cocoa pod from the harvest season. Sweet!
lines.avatar.harvest-crown.v1: A crown of golden wheat, for a harvest king or queen.
lines.avatar.praline.v1: Hey, that's me! Wear my face, and we'll be twins.
lines.avatar.bramble.v1: Bramble the beaver, a busy builder who loves a plan.
lines.avatar.zippy.v1: Zippy the squirrel, the fastest player in the forest!
lines.avatar.shelly.v1: Shelly the tortoise. Slow and careful wins the game.
lines.avatar.rocco.v1: Rocco the raccoon, full of clever little tricks.
lines.avatar.ivy.v1: Ivy the giraffe, who always sees the whole board.
lines.avatar.onyx.v1: Onyx the raven, sharp eyed and very wise.
lines.avatar.ember.v1: Ember the dragon, the strongest player of all. Brave!
lines.avatar.miu.v1: Miu the cat, from Ancient Egypt. Elegant and clever.
lines.avatar.sophie.v1: Sophie the owl, from Ancient Greece. The wisest friend around.
lines.avatar.marcus.v1: Marcus the wolf, from Ancient Rome. Bold and loyal.
lines.avatar.moti.v1: Moti the elephant, from Mughal India. Gentle and strong.
lines.avatar.bao.v1: Bao the panda, from Ming China. Calm, kind, and very patient.
lines.avatar.marco.v1: Marco the winged lion, the proud guardian of Venice.
lines.avatar.gaston.v1: Gaston the rooster, from Paris. Cock a doodle doo!
lines.avatar.mishka.v1: Mishka the bear, from snowy Russia. Big, warm hugs!
lines.avatar.skye.v1: Skye the eagle, soaring above New York. Fly high!
lines.frame.none.v1: No frame at all, nice and simple.
lines.frame.bronze.v1: A shiny bronze ring, for players who are getting good.
lines.frame.silver.v1: A bright silver ring. You're really going places!
lines.frame.gold.v1: A gold ring, only for the most dedicated players.
lines.frame.ruby.v1: A deep ruby ring that glows like a jewel.
lines.frame.harvest.v1: A wreath of harvest gold, from the Cocoa Harvest season.
lines.frame.cocoa-gold.v1: Gold over cocoa enamel. Rich and sweet.
lines.frame.ember.v1: A glowing ring of cacao embers. Warm and fiery!
